title: Event attachment — shared definitions for the vtc/events/attachments/* spec family
description: What an event has attached (VTI Community Events chapter, VTI-EVT-240 – 252): a community room bound to its roster, a board whose audience is the event, an election, or a material released to each registrant who is going. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

EventAttachmentId.title: EventAttachmentId
EventAttachmentId.description: Opaque identifier of one attachment: `att_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters, unique within the community.

EventAttachmentKind.title: EventAttachmentKind
EventAttachmentKind.description: `room`: a community room bound to the event's roster (VTI-EVT-240 – 242), only on a `visible` roster. `optInRoom`: a room a registrant enters only by their own act, offered on a `hidden` roster (VTI-EVT-244). `board`: a board whose audience is the event (VTI-EVT-250). `election`: a community election linked to the event. `material`: a file or page released to each registrant who is going (VTI-EVT-243).

EventRoomAdmits.title: EventRoomAdmits
EventRoomAdmits.description: Whom a bound room admits (VTI-EVT-241). `going`: registrants who are going. `goingAndMaybe`: also those who said maybe — only on a `visible` roster.

EventMaterial.title: EventMaterial
EventMaterial.description: A material released to each registrant who is going, as access details are (VTI-EVT-243): a name and an `https` address, or a record in a room the registrant may read.

url.description: Where it is, as an `https` address. No other scheme.

EventAttachment.title: EventAttachment
EventAttachment.description: One attachment, as its reader may see it. Exactly the member its `kind` names is present: `roomId` for `room` and `optInRoom`, `boardId` for `board`, `electionId` for `election`, `material` for `material`.

eventId.description: The event it is attached to.

admits.description: For `room`: whom it admits. Absent means `going`.

disclosure.description: For `optInRoom`: what a registrant is told before entering — that those in it see each other. Plain text.

boardId.description: The board, by its identifier (`vtc/boards` 0.2, whose audience may be an event).

electionId.description: The community election, by its identifier.
